chapter: Earl Hines, Chicago and later gigs
title: Choosing Earl Hines over Chick Webb
summary: He had only played New York theaters in shows, and chose Hines over Webb because he liked Jimmy Mundy's arrangements.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: When you were with Earl's band in Chicago and doing all these things, you had not yet played in New York, is that right, or had you?
I had played in New York but only with those big bands I told you where we played those theaters, Apollo Theater and those theaters.
But I hadn't done nothing on my own or
nothing like -- you know, I wasn't known. Nobody knew me but a few musicians.knew me.
Well, you played the theater circuit and --

That's all. Playing back in shows and things of this sort. No, I didn't really get to do any playing, any real playing around there. Mostly show work. But I had been in New York. I knew New York, and I knew a lot of musicians around there and they knew me because I had a chance to either go with Earl Hines or Chick Webb.

And I went with Earl instead because of Jimmy Mundy was there. And, you know, I knew what he's going to write, and I -- the things he wrote. And I enjoyed his arrangements. And I didn't know any -- I didn't -- wasn't familiar with a lot of the guys with Chick. The guy who wanted me with Chick's band bad was from Washington, and he's a trombone player. It was Sandy Williams.
